ticket: Browser T06 multi-target production path and gate
findingDetails: Task UI/service create only one target; no add/remove target, select all/none or explicit ready-only preview. Core sender supports multi-row execution but it is not reachable through ordinary production UI.
All-target preflight exits at first error without reporting each selected target readiness. Persisted ready status is not a fresh site check.
UI acting lock covers the entire send/capture promise and disables independent visibility changes.
Sender owns page IDs only inside its own instance. Common BrowserControl/legacy bridge mutations and preparation are not admitted against a shared task/page/profile/generation lease.

Explicit recollect/retry-send/takeover/resume actions are absent. Save retry exists and stays disk-only. Batch stage/commit/rollback and pause tests already cover core safety, but native multi-provider failure/recovery has not been exercised.
implemented: Workspace and registered public API add/remove target bindings through validated browser profiles; same provider can have distinct binding IDs. Adding targets does not select recipients or open pages. Removing targets preserves prior turn/answer snapshots and closes the current presentation.
Task UI exposes add/remove and select-all/clear-recipient actions. Visibility changes now remain available during the long send/capture operation and do not change recipients.

Target membership edits invalidate task previews by their actual turn-keyed IDs. New regression covers unselected/invisible additions, duplicate provider identities, unsupported providers and immutable past answers.

Fresh read-only preflight checks every selected binding and reports readiness; default preview rejects all input if any target fails. Explicit ready-only preview freezes the eligible subset without changing saved recipients. Draft/recipient edits and rebinding invalidate previews/checks.

Shared PageOwnership admits task sessions against typed control and authenticated bridge mutations. Ordinary control calls retain the existing serial queue and close cancellation. Pause revokes old task admission; late known receipts survive; takeover explicitly reveals a bound page and resume only rechecks readiness.
Removing a binding now persists membership first and closes the captured presentation after, avoiding a close-before-edit race. No historical turn/capture is removed.

Native three-guest test exposed CDP text entering the previously focused guest despite the host webview focus. A verified native editor click now establishes input routing before selection/insertion. Host and editor focus/readback guards remain. webContents.isFocused was experimentally unsuitable on Windows and was removed; ordinary browser32 and internal provider17 checks pass after removal.
If send-time preflight fails before attempts exist, every untouched exchange now reports not-sent with the failure reason instead of remaining idle. Save retry remains disk-only.

Bilingual guide covers membership, fresh readiness, ready subset, takeover and control exclusion; stale no-multiple-accounts/Linux-only claims corrected. Stable module and shell contracts updated with pre-edit backups.

Read-only recollect now requires a confirmed submission receipt, verified same conversation/profile/provider and the original user message in the current branch. It never creates an attempt or touches website drafts. Capture revisions are retained, newest partial stays current, and explicit history expands lazily with keyboard/touch controls. Save-failed complete recollection is retained for disk-only retry.

Explicit previewRetry/retrySend freezes the original prompt, one current binding and the complete last-attempt context. Fresh read-only inspection precedes review; one-use confirmation adds only that target attempt through the shared sender. Previous unknown attempts and successful exchanges remain intact; edited tasks/bindings invalidate review; pending sends can be paused before provider admission.

Journal evidence is refreshed before native execution and disk-only retry. Newly durable acceptance blocks stale resend; a rolled-back failed intent can clear its error by re-reading durable state without replaying that intent.

designNotes: Fresh readiness should inspect every selected bound page without native input/focus, retain per-target reasons, reject default preview if any fail, and allow explicit ready-only turn snapshot without changing saved recipient selection.
